# rvtt.exp results that are known to fail and must not fail the build.
#
# One whole result line per entry, copied verbatim from a .sum file, e.g.
#   FAIL: g++.target/riscv/tt/rv/zbkb.C (test for excess errors)
# FAIL, UNRESOLVED, ERROR and XPASS lines are compared; the check is a set
# difference, never a count, so a fixed test is reported as a stale entry
# and a new failure fails the job by name.
#
# Empty because the suite is clean in this configuration: at PR head
# 2598aef7ad0 the fork run reported 1175 expected passes and 2 expected
# failures, with no FAIL, UNRESOLVED, ERROR or XPASS.  Expected failures are
# marked in the tests themselves with dg-xfail-if and never appear here.
